design: Fresh 48-world validation of frozen C20 adaptive breadth gate
frozen_rule: spawn second swarm iff baseline unique proposals <=4 OR normalized top-score margin <0.20
interpretation: C20 is nearly recovery-equivalent and nearly achieves the compute target, but fails both preregistered thresholds. Repeated hand-tuning of scalar breadth gates is not justified. Retain uniform width-2 as the supported benchmark and move to model-class transfer/generalization testing.
next: EXP-002J model misspecification transfer, beginning with nonlinear additive SCMs while inference remains linear-Gaussian.
